d: The death of the Eurydice area in the area around Thebes. In the background a cornfield. On the left the hut of Aristeus, with the inscription above the door: "Aristeus, honey producer engross and endsail. Depôt in the mountain Hymettus." On the right the hut of Orpheus, with the inscription: "Orpheus, director of the Conservatory of Thebes; also gives music lessons."
